{"metadata":{"description":"dsh-memory is a local, Git-backed long-term-memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).","id":"gh:1339286962","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-memory","slug":"seriousz158/dsh-memory","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-bundle","dsh-plugin","memory"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"dsh-memory is a local, Git-backed long-term-memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-memory"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"`dsh-memory` is a local, Git-backed long-term-memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"It adds one persistent setting, a safe settings-page workflow for clearing memories, and an optional"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" idle-session synchronizer. The host plugin injects memory guidance only when `memory.enabled` is tr"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ue; the UI plugin lets a user inspect the repository state, toggle the setting, and clear learned me"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"mory through a deliberate two-step confirmation."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Stores durable memory in a local Git repository, not in this source repository or a hosted service"},{"id":"p6s2","text":".
- Registers the `memory` settings namespace immediately, so `memory.enabled` takes effect for the "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"next model call without restarting DSH.
- Shows a long-term-memory row in DSH settings with reposito"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ry status and a double-confirmation **Delete memory** action.
- Preserves a Git recovery point befor"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"e clearing `summary.md`, `handbook/`, `rollouts/`, and `archive/`: a clean repository reuses its exi"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"sting HEAD, while dirty target paths get a dedicated checkpoint commit; the next commit records the "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"cleared state.
- Refuses unsafe repository layouts, symbolic-link escapes, non-repository roots, and"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" path races during a clear operation.
- Can process only idle local session logs through an optional"},{"id":"p6s9","text":" headless synchronizer. The synchronizer defaults to `workspace-write`, never silently installs DSH,"},{"id":"p6s10","text":" and forwards only an allowlisted environment."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Capabilities"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"This README describes stable user-facing behavior. Release-by-release
implementation details are int"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"entionally kept out of this page; see
CHANGELOG.md and the GitHub releases
for historical changes."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Local Git-backed memory"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- Memory stays in a local Git repository. There is no hosted memory service or
cloud vector database"},{"id":"p10s2","text":".
- Markdown records support front matter, namespaced ids, provenance, expiry
projection, determinis"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"tic conflict handling, and legacy compatibility.
- `summary.md` is a short navigation snapshot; deta"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"iled knowledge belongs in
`handbook/`, `rollouts/`, and `archive/`."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Safe synchronization and recovery"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- Optional idle-session sync runs in a private per-run workspace. The model can
edit only the isolat"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ed copy; the host validates and writes the live Git
repository.
- The host provides dry-run/preview/"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"apply flows, operation locking, health
checks, bounded batches, retry backoff, duplicate-id diagnost"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ics, and
metadata-only journals.
- Recovery/apply commits, rollback, backup export/import, and legac"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"y migration
keep changes auditable and reversible. Migration is available through the
CLI/host API, "},{"id":"p12s6","text":"not the settings UI."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Read path"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- When enabled, a bounded and explicitly untrusted `summary.md` snapshot is
available to the model ("},{"id":"p14s2","text":"12 KiB maximum).
- `memory.search()` and `memory.context()` provide local, bounded retrieval
with so"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"urce citations and usage-aware deterministic ordering. Retrieval is
hybrid: a derived SQLite index ("},{"id":"p14s4","text":"FTS5 trigram + CJK-bigram/word terms, stored
at `.sync/search-index.sqlite` with restrictive permiss"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ions) is fused with
lexical scoring and exact-substring precedence, and transparently falls back
to "},{"id":"p14s6","text":"a pure scan when the index is missing, stale, or corrupt.
- Read usage is stored as private metadata"},{"id":"p14s7","text":" in `.sync/usage.json`; transcripts,
prompts, credentials, and memory content are not written to jou"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"sync/usage.json`; transcripts,
prompts, credentials, and memory content are not written to journals."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### DSH settings integration"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The settings UI provides the memory toggle, repository status, recent-sync
state, preview actions, r"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ollback, and deliberate clear confirmation. It does
not expose the filesystem root or execute Git di"},{"id":"p16s3","text":", and deliberate clear confirmation. It does
not expose the filesystem root or execute Git directly."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`v0.10.0` targets the DSH desktop app 0.2.x and keeps the 0.1.x web runtime
